name: Suba
description: Suba was a planet located in the Atravis sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt found the Malicious Moondog, a cantina on Suba, no more nastier than the cantina on Rajtiri, the Wanton Wellspring.
lead_paragraphs: Suba was a planet located in the Atravis sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt found the Malicious Moondog, a cantina on Suba, no more nastier than the cantina on Rajtiri, the Wanton Wellspring.
